narrative:
Compared to the last report, Demand is light for all qualities of hay. Movement has been moderate throughout the whole state due to fuel prices and most everyone has the inventory they need for the time being. Some producers are holding onto their hay waiting to see what prices do while others are selling what they can now. Prices have been steady. According to the U.S. drought monitor website, 66% of the state is in a Moderate drought or worse, 36% is in a Severe drought or worse, 5% is in an Extreme drought.
